summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories like Hugging Face, which crossed 3 million public models in August 2026, and a growing field of developer-facing inference platforms (Together AI, Fireworks AI, Replicate, SiliconFlow, Ollama, and others) that serve open-weight models via APIs or local runtimes. Download distribution is highly concentrated—roughly half of Hugging Face models have fewer than 200 downloads while the top 0.01% account for nearly half of all downloads—and the geography of open-source adoption has shifted, with China surpassing the U.S. in monthly model downloads. These platforms differ from enterprise aggregators (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) and MLOps suites (SageMaker, Vertex AI) by focusing on open-weight model hosting, distribution, and low-friction inference.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central hub for hosting, sharing, and discovering open-source AI models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), with hosted inference and training tooling.
platforms.model_count: ~3 million+ public models (crossed 3M in August 2026, ~747K added in 2026 YTD)
platforms.pricing: Free for public repos and basic usage; Pro at ~$9/mo; Enterprise Hub from ~$20/user/mo; Inference Endpoints and serverless inference billed by compute/usage; dedicated GPU Spaces billed hourly.
features: Massive model and dataset repository with Git-based versioning
Transformers, Diffusers, and other open-source libraries
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Spaces for hosting interactive demos (Gradio/Streamlit/Docker)
Download stats, model cards, and community discussions
AutoTrain and fine-tuning tooling
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers needing the broadest selection of open models, datasets, and collaborative hosting.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A local-first runtime that makes it easy to download, run, and manage open LLMs on personal machines and servers with a simple CLI and API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek, Phi, etc.), plus GGUF imports from Hugging Face
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source; runs locally on your own hardware with no usage fees.
features: One-command model download and local inference
Local REST API compatible with OpenAI-style endpoints
Cross-platform (macOS, Windows, Linux) with GPU acceleration
Quantized GGUF model support for consumer hardware
Modelfiles for custom prompts and model configuration
Direct import of models from Hugging Face
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run open models locally without cloud costs.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running and deploying open-source models (and custom containers) via a simple API, with strong support for image, video, and audio generation.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models (via Cog-packaged containers)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU pricing); public models priced per run; custom deployments billed by active hardware.
features: Run thousands of open models via a unified API
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Strong multimodal support (image, video, audio, LLMs)
Automatic scaling and cold-start management
Simple webhook and streaming support
No infrastructure management required
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups wanting quick API access to generative models without managing GPUs.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference and fine-tuning cloud for open-weight LLMs and multimodal models, aimed at production-scale deployment.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference (priced per million tokens by model size); dedicated GPU endpoints billed hourly; fine-tuning priced per token/job.
features: OpenAI-compatible inference API
Optimized high-throughput, low-latency serving
Fine-tuning and dedicated endpoints
Support for the largest open models including DeepSeek and Llama variants
GPU clusters for training and research
Batch inference and JSON mode support
platforms.best_for: Teams building production applications on open models that need scalable, cost-efficient inference.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A speed-optimized inference platform for open-weight LLMs and multimodal models, emphasizing low latency and production reliability.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FireFunction, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing by model size; on-demand and reserved dedicated GPU deployments billed hourly; fine-tuning available.
features: FireAttention-optimized high-speed inference engine
OpenAI-compatible API
Function calling and structured output support
Fine-tuning and LoRA deployment
Multimodal and embedding model support
Dedicated deployments for predictable latency
platforms.best_for: Developers prioritizing fast, low-latency inference and function-calling for production LLM apps.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: An inference platform (strong in the China market) serving a broad range of open-weight LLM, image, and audio models through a unified API.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Llama, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token/usage pricing with competitive rates; free tier/credits for some models; dedicated instances available.
features: OpenAI-compatible inference API
Strong coverage of Chinese open models (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM)
Text, image, audio, and video generation endpoints
Cost-optimized serverless inference
Fine-tuning and dedicated deployment options
Fast adoption aligned with China's rising share of open-model usage
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asia) wanting affordable access to leading Chinese and global open models.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway that routes requests across many open and proprietary model providers, letting developers access hundreds of models through one endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models across dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passthrough pricing plus a small platform fee; no subscription required; some free models available.
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Automatic fallback and provider routing
Price and latency comparison across providers
Access to both open and proprietary models
Unified billing and usage analytics
Model availability aggregation
platforms.best_for: Developers who want provider-agnostic access and easy switching between many models.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform powered by custom LPU hardware, serving open-weight models at very high token throughput.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of open models (Llama, Qwen, Mixtral, Gemma, Whisper, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing by model; free developer tier with rate limits; enterprise plans available.
features: Custom LPU inference hardware for extreme speed
Industry-leading tokens-per-second throughput
OpenAI-compatible API
Low-latency streaming responses
Speech-to-text via Whisper models
Generous free developer tier
platforms.best_for: Developers needing the fastest possible real-time inference for open models.
